title: 第7章 逆天的战力第8章 陈家获得秘宝
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第7章逆天的战力整个北原郡的灵气在不到一天的时间之内被抽空，这让北原郡的修炼者，都是忧心忡忡。
北原郡第一家族南家家主南向天，更是直接来到了郡守府。
“吴兄，这般异象，你可知为何？”
“最近是有什么大人物来到了咱们北原郡吗？”
“若是真有这样的人物，还请吴兄告知，我也好吩咐族人，小心行事，切莫得罪。”
看到南向天这严肃地模样，北原郡郡守吴成峰也是无奈的苦笑一声。
如今的他也是一头雾水，完全搞不清楚，为何突然之间，四周灵气竟然消失的一干二净。
“南兄，此事，我确实毫不知情。”
“我更没听说，最近有哪位强者莅临咱们北原郡。”
“莫非，是咱们北原郡之中，有天才之辈降生？”吴成峰皱着眉头说道。
“哦？若当真如此，更要调查清楚，能有这般异动，将来必定会成为一方巨擘，早日拉拢结交，日后必有回报！”南向天略显亢奋的说道。
“不错，不管是什么，都应该调查清楚。”
“这样，你我共同调查，谁先有了结果，就先通知谁。”
南向天和吴成峰两个人准备调查灵气被消失的原因，而另一边，柳梦妍两人还没有离开北原郡。
当灵气突然莫名其妙被抽空的那一刻，柳梦妍两人第一个想法，便是陈家老祖陈长安。
“太可怕了，族叔，这陈家老祖的修为，究竟达到了什么程度？”
柳梦妍如今是真的害怕了，若是陈家老祖睚眦必报，柳家能幸免于难吗？
“深不可测，无法估量。”
“从我们离开陈家不久之后，灵气就突然消失，咱们两人全速赶路，如今已经快要离开北原郡，但我依然没有察觉到一丝一毫的灵气波动。”
“这说明，他在这么短的时间之内，将整个北原郡的灵气都抽空了。”柳乘风一脸紧张的表情。
“族叔，我不懂，他为什么要这么做？抽空北原郡的灵气，对陈家人应该也没有好处吧？”
“这么多的灵气，恢复恐怕也需要一些时日。”柳梦妍不解的问道。
“警告，在我看来，这就是他给我们的警告，同样也是给北原郡的一个警告。”
“北原郡发生异动，必定有人调查，最后便会知晓，陈家老祖回归！”
“到了那个时候，消息会传遍整个大周国。”
“陈家……这是在为崛起造势！”
“看样子，不久之后，陈家将会重登大周国第一家族之位，甚至……”
“甚至什么？”
“陈家根本就不在意大周国了。”
柳乘风的分析，让柳梦妍感觉十分有道理。
竟然是如此，否则的话，陈长安那样的人物，又何须搞出来这样的事情呢？
content_en:
Chapter 7: Heaven-defying Combat Power The entire Beiyuan County’s spiritual energy was drained in less than a day, which made the practitioners in Beiyuan County worried.
Nan Xiangtian, the head of the Nan family, the first family in Beiyuan County, came directly to the governor's mansion.
"Brother Wu, do you know the reason for such a strange phenomenon?"
"Has any big shot come to our Beiyuan County recently?"
"If there really is such a person, please tell Brother Wu so that I can tell the clansmen to be careful and not to offend him."
Seeing Nan Xiangtian's serious look, Wu Chengfeng, the governor of Beiyuan County, also gave a helpless smile.
Now he is also at a loss. He has no idea why all the spiritual energy around him suddenly disappeared.
"Brother Nan, I really don't know anything about this matter."
"I haven't even heard of any powerful person visiting our Beiyuan County recently."
"Could it be that a genius is born in our Beiyuan County?" Wu Chengfeng said with a frown.
"Oh? If this is really the case, we must investigate clearly. If there is such a change, he will definitely become a giant in the future. If you win over him as soon as possible, you will be rewarded in the future!" Nan Xiangtian said slightly excitedly.
"Yes, no matter what it is, it should be investigated clearly."
"In this way, you and I will investigate together, and whoever gets the results first will be notified first."
"Okay."
Nan Xiangtian and Wu Chengfeng were preparing to investigate the reason for the disappearance of spiritual energy. On the other hand, Liu Mengyan had not yet left Beiyuan County.
When the spiritual energy was suddenly and inexplicably drained out, the first thought of Liu Mengyan and the two of them was Chen Changan, the ancestor of the Chen family.
"It's too scary, clan uncle, what level of cultivation has this ancestor of the Chen family reached?"
Liu Mengyan is really scared now. If the ancestor of the Chen family is determined to retaliate, will the Liu family be spared?
"Unfathomable and immeasurable."
"Not long after we left the Chen family, the spiritual energy suddenly disappeared. The two of us rushed at full speed. Now we are almost leaving Beiyuan County, but I still haven't noticed any fluctuations in the spiritual energy."
"This shows that he drained the entire Beiyuan County of spiritual energy in such a short period of time." Liu Chengfeng had a nervous expression on his face.
"Uncle, I don't understand, why would he do this? Taking away Beiyuan County's spiritual energy would not be good for the Chen family, right?"
"With so much spiritual energy, I'm afraid it will take some time to recover." Liu Mengyan asked in confusion.
"Warning, in my opinion, this is the warning he gave us, and it is also a warning to Beiyuan County."
"There is something strange happening in Beiyuan County. Someone must investigate, and eventually they will know that the ancestor of the Chen family has returned!"
"At that time, the news will spread throughout the Great Zhou Kingdom."
"The Chen family... is building momentum for their rise!"
"It seems that in the near future, the Chen family will regain its position as the first family in the Great Zhou Kingdom, and even..."
"Even what?"
"The Chen family doesn't care about the Great Zhou Kingdom at all."
Liu Chengfeng's analysis made Liu Mengyan feel very reasonable.
This is actually the case. Otherwise, why would a person like Chen Changan do such a thing?
